Litchi Lake Station is a station on New Edward Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Punctual. Passengers may also use this station to change to Friendly Railways Punctual Line (Litchi Lake Station) and Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line, Hook Sand Rapid (Litchi Lake Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station has been jokingly referred to as a "Strawberry Raspberry Cheesecake", with the Pink Wool and Pink Terracotta corresponding to Strawberry and Raspberry respectively.[2]

History[]

  • July 1 2017: New Edward Line extended from Justin Station to Hourglass Bay Station through this Station and Newmonth River Station.
  • January 15 2018: Through Service between New Edward Line and East Ring Line Kelper Mount Station is added at Platform 2 of this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is built to commemorate the fact that the people who are meant to meet the Railway Builder (Nazca) are always late, and the Chinese Name of this station alludes to the term "Always Late".[2]
  • While the namesake of Justin Station is also due to lateness, more details on the namesake of that station will be seen at Justin Station.
  • While the namesake of this station is related to people being late, the design of this station also alludes to the fruit Lychee.
  • The clock at the top of this station points to 3 o'clock. This is due to the fact that this station completed construction at 3am.[3]

History[]

  • November 29 2016: This station began services, turning New Edward Line into the third longest line in Nazca Railway at the time.[4]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Sylphic Mound.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Sylphic Mound 02:15
Poppied Requiem 03:09

Fun Facts[]

  • As this Station completed construction on Remembrance Day, a Cenotaph which is inspired by the Cenotaph in Hong Kong, which in turn is an almost exact replica of the Cenotaph in Whitehall, London, is erected next to Exit A of this Station.
  • As this station stands in the way between West Hill Station and Winter Point Gateway, when relevant sections for Asylum Line, Snowty Line and Mike Line were built in S4E8[2], these tracks pass through the south of the Station Structure or beneath the Station before turning north, forming a special case.

History[]

  • November 9 2025: This Station began construction.
  • November 11 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • November 12 2025: Rover Line extends from Amongus Lake Station to Winter Point Gateway through this station.

title: Local Rapid Transit
safeHtml:
Local Rapid Transits (LRTs) (Formally named Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Local Rapid Transit System) are regional rail systems operated by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

Contents

  • 1 Concept
  • 2 Proper Nouns
    • 2.1 Stop
  • 3 List of LRT Systems and Lines
  • 4 Development Mode
  • 5 Operation Mode
  • 6 Development Chapters
  • 7 Citations
  • 8 References
    • 8.1 Shore Tip LRT
    • 8.2 Sexterade LRT
    • 8.3 Peckern North LRT

Concept[]

LRTs, as its name suggests, is designed to be a railway system serving the vicinity to which it belonged to. It is a new railway mode that Nazca Railway established after the Standard Railway and Sub-Standard Railway. Taking the Standard Railway as a whole, Sub-Standard Railways are three quarters that of the scale of Standard Railways, and SLTs is a quarter that of the Standard Railway. However, LRTs are designed to be half the scale of Standard Railways, between Sub-Standard Railways and SLTs.

Proper Nouns[]

Stop[]

"Stop" is the term for "Stations" in LRTs.

List of LRT Systems and Lines[]

  • Shore Tip LRT (Serving the Shore Tip area in Internal Sea)
    • 1 Tung Wik Line
    • 2 Ting Wik Line
  • Sexterade LRT (Serving the Sexterade area in Twenty-Second)
    • 1 Pak Kei Line
    • 2 Sheung Yam Line
    • 3 Tsing Lam Line
  • Peckern North LRT (Serving the Dansein and Tin Shek areas in Peckern North)
    • 1 Tin Kam Line

Development Mode[]

Similar to The Shuttle, LRTs run as independent rail systems. They do not appear in Main Chapters of Nazca Railway, but would randomly appear in different places. However, an exception to this occurred when Peckern North LRT was established during Pre-Season 4 Phase 3.

Operation Mode[]

Normally, the platform of a Stop would not exceed 76m long. Stop facilities would also be simpler than stations, featuring only toilets, Minecart Claim areas and Station teleports. However, sign boards used by stops would be the same as that of stations. Moreover, platforms would use Medjay Platform Gates that are specifically designed for LRTs. Besides of doors opening and closing, LRTs would not feature audio announcements with only visual announcements.

The Departure Routine would also be simplified in a manner that Passengers either have to manually start the Departure Routine at every station or move the Minecart out of the station. In turn, the simplified Departure Routine has halved the departure time taken when compared to conventional Departure Routines.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first Cavern Station ever built. Cavern Station are defined by Stations being constructed within a large underground cavern that is only connected to the walls of the cavern by support pillars.
  • This Station is located directly to the South of Darey Terrace Station. However, these two Stations are not directly connected.[2]
  • As the Estate (Tsik Yam Estate) is built on a Plateau, three elevators are provided to each exit to cater for use from residents since Stairs are not viable.[3]

History[]

  • March 2 2021: This Station began services. Vision Line is established.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Gale Monarch.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Gale Monarch 03:25
After the Eye Has Passed 03:37

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station to be built in Season 3.
  • As this station was constructed amidst Typhoon Mangkhut, the large words "Mangkhut" and "Shower" (Both in Chinese) are encraved at the concoruse of this station.
  • The name of this station alludes to one of the players in this server.
  • Being the 222nd Station, this station is the second station to feature three digits of a single number, with the first such station being Purple Gate Station.
  • This station features a bathhouse for each gender at the north end of this station, and is the only station to do so to date.
  • This station is the first and currently the only station at which the Departure Routine of this station is completely flat (i.e. No Brick is placed at the point of boarding which is one meter above the track).

History[]

  • September 17 2018: This station began services.
  • July 22 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[3]
  • August 14 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

title: Los Sengas
safeHtml:
Los Sengas, originally named Metropolis (Now the other name of Downtown), is the official name of the City World of Project Nazca. Los Sengas is based on "Limited Creative Modes", and is established on March 2015.

Districts[]

Transport[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Los Sengas Transport.

The three main modes of transport in Los Sengas are Rail Transport, Ferry Transport and Road Transport.

Rail Transport[]

The main modes of rail transport in Los Sengas include Nazca Railway, SLT and other private railways included in the Co-op Railway scheme.

Ferry Transport[]

Ferry Transport in Los Sengas is mainly provided by the Nazca Ferry Co. Ltd. (Also known as the NFC). However, other private ferry companies, such as Hatace Ferry Corporation Limited are also available.

Road Transport[]

Los Sengas currently has 10 main Trunk Roads scattered across Los Sengas, and the road transport is currently expanding. Moreover, Bus Operators, such as NR Buses, are also available.

Government[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Los Sengas Government.

The Government of Los Sengas was the general term used to group all different departments of the Los Sengas Government. However, currently, the Los Sengas Government has been disbanded.

Plots[]

Initial devleopment in different areas of Los Sengas usually involve a series of plots being set up in that area. Players who seek for a plot can apply for a plot through administrators who are online. However, most administrators nowadays adopt a development mode of high-density, high-storey building construction. Therefore, new plots in newer development areas have become rarer.

Public Facilities[]

The Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals is a completed infrastructural project in Los Sengas used for commercial freight.

Mark 4[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Mark 4.

Mark 4 was a Lottery in Los Sengas. However, it has been abolished.

Horse Spawning Stations[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Horse Spawning Station.

Media[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Los Sengas Media.

Media in Los Sengas is regulated by the Media and Broadcasting Authority (MBA), and could be divided into public broadcasting institutes and private broadcasting institutes:

  • Inter-Galactic Media Group (IGMG) (Public Broadcasting Institute)
  • World Gazette (WG)
  • Genesis Post (GP)

Permanent Corporations[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Los Sengas Permanent Corporations.

Los Sengas Permanent Corporations are privately owned companies in Los Sengas that have permission to do business in accordance to the Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation.

Legal System[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Los Sengas Legal System.

Los Sengas Building Teams[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Los Sengas Building Teams.
  • According to the 26th Conference, the Building Team system was established. Players in Los Sengas can organise teams to build large-scale construction projects in it.
  • However, according to the 29th Conference, on July 29 2019 applications for new Building Teams were no longer accepted, and are now replaced by Architects.

title: Los Sengas Government
safeHtml:
The Government of Los Sengas was the collective name of all governmental departments in Los Sengas. It was established on May 15 2016 and was disbanded on July 29 2019.[1]

In recent years, people in Los Sengas have rarely mentioned about govenrmental departments in Los Sengas, and administrators now rarely operate under the name of the governmental departments. Ultimately, all the departments have been scrapped.

Government Departments[]

title: Los Sengas Legal System
safeHtml:
The Los Sengas Legal System basically follows the laws of the area (Hong Kong SAR) at which Project Nazca is based on, and adopts the Common Law system. Besides of being subject to Hong Kong SAR laws, Los Sengas also has its own set of policies and regulations, and are executed by related authorities.

title: Los Sengas Media
safeHtml:
Los Sengas Media was mainly regulated by the Media and Broadcasting Authority in the Los Sengas Government. They can be categorized into Public Service Broadcaster (PSB) and Licensed Media Organization (LMO), and are regulated through the POSA.

Contents

  • 1 Related Laws
    • 1.1 POSA (Chinese Only)
    • 1.2 Los Sengas Regulations on classification and registration of Media organizations
  • 2 List of Public Service Broadcasters (PSB)
  • 3 List of Licensed Media Organizations (LMO)
  • 4 Citations and References

Related Laws[]

POSA (Chinese Only)[]

納斯卡計劃伺服器設立第四權，媒體作為中立組織並監察納斯卡計劃伺服器管理員、管理長及總管理長的一切行為、言論及政策。納斯卡計劃伺服器管理員、管理長及總管理長必須且絕對尊重納斯卡計劃伺服器內媒體的一切合理言論、討論及批判。納斯卡計劃伺服器內負責媒體的任何人員不得在納斯卡計劃伺服器內執行任何處分。

－【最高權力蓋印 POSA】（節錄）

Los Sengas Regulations on classification and registration of Media organizations[]

1. Aim of regulation
To identify personnels of Media organizations from ordinary citizens and to offer appropriate aid when needed.
2. Interpretation
In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires-
"Chief administrator" means the chief administrator of the Project Nazca Server;
"Media director" means the media director of the Project Nazca Server;
"government" means the government of Los Sengas;
3. Classification of Media Organizations:
3.1. Public Service Broadcaster (IGMG)
3.2. Licensed Media Organization: Media organizations licensed through a certain procedure.
4. Registration of Media Organizations
4.1 Licensed Media Organizations
A proposal should be submitted to the general meeting of the server, and be approved by two-third of the participants present.
5. Media License Reviews
To maintain quality of the Public Service Broadcaster and the licensed media organizations,the review of media licenses shall be conducted annually.Before the review,the person in-charge of the organization reviewed should submit a report containing their productions produced and their future plans.
The government may decide not to renew the license for a media organization,but adequate time should be given.*

  • This is not applicable to the Public Service Broadcaster

7. Regulations on posts
All Media Organizations are given a code upon registration in order to help readers identify the type and name of the media.
7.1 Regulations on posts
All posts issued by all media organizations shall show its code at the beginning of the post in the following format-
[media category]-[code of media organization]
7.2 Code for category of media organization
1. Public Service Broadcaster - PSB
2. Licensed Media Organization - LMO

－Media and Broadcasting Authority,Los Sengas Regulations on classification and registration of Media organizations

title: Los Sengas NR Station Upgrade Scheme
displayTitle: Los Sengas NR Station Upgrade Scheme
aliases: Los Sengas NR Station Upgrade Scheme
safeHtml:
Los Sengas NR Station Upgrade Scheme is a scheme that is divided into six phases. The aim of this scheme is to upgrade earlier existing stations in order to have them match the outlook and facilities of new stations. Most of the upgrading works involve facility upgrading and platform upgrading.

Contents

  • 1 Aim
  • 2 Upgrading Works
    • 2.1 Phase I
    • 2.2 Phase II (ImageOnMap (IoM) Updating Works)
    • 2.3 Phase III (SignPicture Updating Works Phase I)
    • 2.4 Phase IV (SignPicture Updating Works Phase II)
    • 2.5 Phase V (NR Station Gauntlet)
    • 2.6 Phase VI (Station Title)
  • 3 Works Progress
    • 3.1 Phase I
    • 3.2 Phase II (ImageOnMap (IoM) Updating Works)
    • 3.3 Phase III (SignPicture Updating Works Phase I)
    • 3.4 Phase IV (SignPicture Updating Works Phase II)
    • 3.5 Phase V (NR Station Gauntlet)
    • 3.6 Phase VI (Station Title)
  • 4 Citations and References

Aim[]

Nazca Railway adds in different advanced facilities and platform equipment in order to unify the system of all Nazca Railway stations in Los Sengas and help it mature.

Upgrading Works[]

Phase I[]

  • Advanced Station Facilities: Insert advanced station facilities for all stations, including "Station Control Room", "Station Souvenir", "Lavatories", "Station Maps" and "Coffee Shops".
  • Station Control Room: While Nazca Railway Stations in Terracept had Station Control Rooms, at the earliest days of the Los Sengas Division station control rooms were not set up. However, they resurfaced in Rover Down Checkpoint, and includes the following fafcilities:
    • Platform Screen Door Controls
    • In-Room Station Teleportation
    • Station Exit Switches
  • Station Souvenirs:
    • Some Souvenirs can be taken once only, but they can not be taken out of Los Sengas. However, some can be taken repeatedly, and other souvenirs involve challenges.
    • Due to city development and technical issues, some of the Station Souvenirs have been demolished (Ones that are demolished are denoted with a strikethrough).
    • Since the commencement of Phase V, they are gradually being replaced by the "NR Gauntlet"

The following denotes the stations contains or contained station souvenirs in increaing order of line number:

  • West Ring Line: Metropolis ([1]), Greenrock Hill, High Approach, Pisces Pond, The Three Pass, Sava Coast, Sava Canyon, West Shoal, Bufly Island, Droplet Island, Axhead Island, Fansim Island, Heeled Island, Caver Island, Gull Woods, Peckern Pond, Peckern Forest, Treeless Hill, Night Curve, Miner North, Numpool, South Bay
  • Expo Line: Purple Gate
  • East Ring Line: Metro Spring, Cyan Loop, High Mesa, Thick River, Saber Tower, Dawn Hill, Kaling Channel, Pier Cliff, Origin Pond
  • Urban Line: TriPaw, Desert Field, Rover Down, Upper Rover
  • New Edward Line: Python Delta, Edward Island, Seat River, Red Stadium, Kaling Sea, Aest, Vein Lake, Flask South
  • Stadium Line: Proyga, Congorge, Stone Shoal, Bulldoze Island, Info Island, Anshield Island, Middle Island, Beam Island, Hatace Island, Bonyal Estate, Origin, Kata River, Katadelphia, Kaling, Flask West, Flask East, Grass Crack, Kong Corner, Raytree. Prosand, Purity Corner ([3])
  • Arcgo Line: Dansein Market ([4]), Landing Pole, Eagle Island, Deepond Island, Inthree Island, Star Island, Mayler, Vayler, Bonyal Bay, Metro River, San Annis, Katadelphia North, Fosina, High Parallel, Internal Sea West, Thin River
  • Luxter Line: Downwell Sand, Upwell Sand ([2]), North Mountain, Coast Edge, White Margin, Ingress South, Ingress Diamond
  • Sava Line: Dragonire Bay
  • Flask Line: Medium Lake, East Margin
  • Daring Line: Blu Trove Bay ([3])
  • Stadow Line: Freedom Bay
  • Daybreaker Line: Anjou
  • Alpha Line: Zootuary
  • Notes:
    • [1]: This Station Souvenir Challenge requires the combined effort of at least seven players before the souvenir can be obtained. The player doing the challenge can invite six other players and have them simultaneously complete the challenge.
    • [2]: Among the existing Station Souvenir Challenges, this one is the hardest. It requires at least two players. While one makes observations, the other does the challenge.
    • [3]: The station souvenirs at Blu Trove Bay and Purity Corner are unofficial.
    • [4]: The station souvenir at Dansein Market is located at the station concourse of the CTRD Station fare area. However, the fare area for Cities Transport is shared with that for Nazca Railway.
  • Station Hopps: At later stages of Nazca Railway Station upgrades, station souvenirs are replaced by "Station Hopps" and are separated by two layers of glass in order to prevent sabotage, such as in Desert Field Station.
  • Due to historical reasons, most of the existing "Station Hopps" have disappeared, and Nazca Railway also ceased the setting up of Station Hopps. Only the glass remained where the station hopps once stood.
  • Lavatories: As its name suggests, lavatories are used for toiletries of passengers. Currently, all stations are equipped with lavatories.
  • Station Maps: Shows the maps of surrounding areas of any station that has ground-level faciltiies. However, Nazca Railway has ceased setting up station maps on newer stations.
  • Coffee Shops: Coffee Shops are formally named Los Sengas Coffee, and they are set up for passengers to obtain food and take a rest.
  • Platform Upgrading Works: Includes "Dynamic Speed Change" and "Closing Screen Doors Flashing Lights":
    • Dynamic Speed Change: Minecarts accelerate and decelerate in a smoother and more realistic behavior when entering and leaving stations.
    • Closing Screen Doors Flashing Lights: When doors of the train are about to close, flashing lights would appear on the platform screen doors. This is so that passengers will know that the train doors are about to close and would not break into the train should they fail to hear announcements.
  • Announcements: Insert "Train Arrival", "Next Station" announcements.

Phase II (ImageOnMap (IoM) Updating Works)[]

  • Using the ImageOnMap (IoM) mod, "Item Frames" can be self-definied and turned into exit signs, lavatory signs and platform signs.
  • Unfortunately, due to the saturation of the number of "ImageOnMap" frames, ImageOnMap signs are gradually phased out from Nazca Railway.

Phase III (SignPicture Updating Works Phase I)[]

  • Replacing all IoM Station signs with SignPicture Signs using the SignPicture Mod, as well as enabling the Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System to appear on signs.

Phase IV (SignPicture Updating Works Phase II)[]

  • Replacing Entry Gate, Station Control Room and Platform Direction signage, which were still at IoM at the time, with SignPicture Signs.

Phase V (NR Station Gauntlet)[]

  • Turn the Station Souvenir challenges in Phase I into "NR Station Gauntlets".
  • Insert station banners that use the Small seal script.

Phase VI (Station Title)[]

  • The official name by NR is "Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme", which includes the following:
    • Adding a "Station Title" for every station.
    • Adding "Station Icons" that correspond to the title.
  • Replacing "Mind the Gap" signs with Line Icons for Platforms.

Works Progress[]

Phase I[]

  • Completed on September 27 2016.
  • Note: All stations and extensions completed on or after Kong Corner (March 25 2016) are already fitted with advanced station facilities, dynamic speed change, closing screen doors flashing lights and announcements upon completion.[1]

Phase II (ImageOnMap (IoM) Updating Works)[]

  • Completed on August 16 2018.
  • Note: All Stations and extensions completed on or after Icelute Island (August 2 2017) are already fitted with IoM Signs upon copmletion.[2]

Phase III (SignPicture Updating Works Phase I)[]

  • Completed on June 19 2020.
  • Note: All Stations and extensions completed on or after Mosaic North (April 15 2020) are already fitted with SignPicture signs upon completion.[3]

Phase IV (SignPicture Updating Works Phase II)[]

  • Completed on October 16 2022.
  • Note: All Stations and extensions completed on or after Clearbrook (June 9 2020) are already fitted with Phase II SignPicture Signs upon completion.[4]

  • Note: All Stations and extensions completed on or after Cheska Hill (January 21 2025) would NOT be fitted with Station Icons until further notice. However, stations and extensions completed in this phase have since been refitted with Station Icons.

title: Los Sengas Permanent Corporations
safeHtml:
Los Sengas Permanent Corporations were a collective name of privately-run companies that have the permission to operate within Los Sengas in accordance with the Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation. However, no new applications have been managed since August 2 2020.

Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation[]

Los Sengas (a.k.a. LS) is a modern theme city in a Minecraft world which for players to visit and develop there. As the city has established for almost a year, more and more players helped and contributed Los Sengas by visiting, building and organizing there. At the same time, when a player owns multiple land properties and wanted to grant government's (Administrators') advanced protection. The LS Government develops formal policy to players who want to establish companies in Los Sengas.

Before applying a permanent corporation in Los Sengas, be sure to check out the followings whether you are eligible to apply:

  • Your warning record must be less than 2
  • You have owned no more than 3 permanent corporations
  • The corporation name must not be the same with the existing one in Los Sengas
  • The corporation should NOT be related to any political opinions
  • The corporation and its applicant should NOT be related to any concept or action against this society

How to apply a permanent corporation:

  • Please click this link to apply ([[1]])
  • You can apply at most 3 permanent corporations at a time, but do not own more than 3 permanent corporation after the application
  • Corporation name must NOT include any offensive or insulting word
  • “Group” or related structure is not considered as a “Permanent Corporation” and will be valid from 1st The Twelfth Month, Year 4
  • The decision of handling the application of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation shall be final

How to shut down a permanent corporation:

  • Please click this link to apply ([[2]])
  • Please make sure the permanent corporation has been operating for not less than 3 months

title: Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme
safeHtml:
The Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme (Usually abbreviated as Co-Op Railway), is a railway development project in Los Sengas. The main aims of this project are to enhance rail connectivity in Los Sengas, and to ensure that players in Los Sengas can, to a limited extent, have the right to construct their own railway systems.

  • July 7: Period 1 Routes announced.

  • July 10: Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu (Then named Mass Transport Railway System Company) Downtown Loop Line copmleted loop, and Metro Stone Branch Line began operations.
  • August 1: Period 2 Routes announced.

  • December 15: Period 3 Routes announced.
  • December 24: Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu Tokaido Line and Nawis Railway (NAR) Peckern Main Line began operations, and held the completion ceremony.
  • December 25: Great City Railway OasisPaw Line began operations.

2018[]

  • April 7: Chinese Express (CE) Yowah Line began operations between Fosina and Prosand.
  • April 10: Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Phase I began operations.
  • June 4: Katadelphia Railway (KR) and Peckern Metro (PM) and Southern Loop became a part of Co-Op Railway and is now subject to Co-Op Railway regulations.
  • July 2: Friendly Railways (FR) Punctual Line began operations.
  • July 30: Downtown Transit (DT) Sirius Line Phase I began operations.
  • August 25: Cities Transit Railway Division (CTRD) Peckern City Circular Phase I began operations.
  • September 6: Period 5 Routes announced.
  • September 8: StarTop Railway (STR) Cadence Line begun construction.
  • September 9: Central-Yowah Railway Yowah Line Cyan Loop Station began operations.
  • October 3: Element Hub Transit (EHT) Hook Sand Line began operations.

2019[]

  • January 2: Nazca Railway completed the inter-railway connecting section between Downtown Transit Sirius Line, Sirius Express Upper Maritime Station and Haisan Railway Peninsula Line Karakuri Palace Station.
  • April 28: StarTop Railway Cadence Line Phase I began operations.
  • August 8: Sea Sky Railway (SSR) MetKing Line began operations between Red Stadium Park and Bonyal South.
  • August 10: Sea Sky Railway MetKing Line completed construction and began operations.
  • August 12:
    • As the reconstruction of Unbalanced Bay Station is now complete, Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line began operations once again.
    • Sea Sky Railway MetKing Line held the completion ceremony at Hung King House Station.
  • October 11: Period 6 (Part 1) Routes announced.

2020[]

  • April 21: Period 6 (Part 2) Routes announced.
  • August 2: Creeper Railway (CR) Pure Water Line Phase 1 began operations, and the section between Waterbelt Garden Station and Gentle Island Station is now open, but as the stations in between were still under construction, they did not open to the public.

2021[]

  • May 21: As Teleturtles, the owner of GCR, was banned from the server, its routes were handed over to Traveller City Transit Railway (TCTR) and Phantasia Metro (PHM).
  • June 5: Creeper Railway Pure Water Line Waterbelt River Station began operations.

2022[]

  • February 25: Nazca, the owner of Project Nazca, announced that Co-Op Railway would no longer be developed in periods:
    • Current Co-Op Railway owners who have completed their existing development and wanted to continue development can contact Nazca.
    • Players who did not participate in the Sandbox Server who are also interested in development and did not have any previous experience can also contact Nazca.
  • February 26:
    • StarTop Railway Cadence Line Vein Lake Station began operations.
    • Cadence Line Phase II completed construction.
  • March 4: Continuous Phase 1 Routes announced.
  • March 14: Continuous Phase 2 Routes announced.
  • March 23: Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Phase II began operations.
  • March 27: Continuous Phase 3 Routes announced.
  • Some time in April: Traveller City Transit Railway lost qualification of Co-Op Railway development, and its only route was handed over to Phantasia Metro.
  • June 7: Continuous Phase 4 Routes announced.
  • August 1: StarTop Railway Cadence Line Phsae III completed construction.
  • October 2: Cities Transit Peckern City Circular Phase II began operations.
  • October 8: Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line Phase II began operations.
  • October 25: Continuous Phase 5 Routes announced. At the same day, Yowah Line was handed over to Central-Yowah Railway (CYR).

2023[]

  • January 24: Continuous Phase 6 Routes announced.
  • March 23: Sea Sky Railway ceased operations. MetKing Line was handed over to Creeper Railway (CR).
  • June 17 (Saturday): Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Peckern Bay Station began operations.
  • June 18 (Sunday):
    • Royal Railway Eastern Line Snowing Flatland Station and Inlight River Station began operations. Eastern Line completed construction.
    • Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Route 5 Station, East Peckern Coast Station and Peckoland Station began operations.
  • June 19 (Monday): MetKing Line resumed operations under Creeper Railway.
  • June 28 (Wednesday): Mass Transport Railway System Company is renamed Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu.
  • July 4 (Tuesday): Continuous Phase 7 Routes announced.
  • August 1 (Tuesday): Peckern Metro ceased operations, and all its lines are temporarily handed over to Nazca Railway.
  • September 29 (Friday):
    • StarTop Railway Cadence Line Brocades Patio Station began operations.
    • Phantasia Metro Neko Line began operations between Twin Cliffs Station and Abunest Station.

2024[]

  • January 27: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line began operations within Oasis Bay.
  • January 28: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line extends its service to Prymea, up to Bay Havhest Station.
  • February 7:
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Solar Sight Station began operations.
    • PTT. Railway Greenwood Line Cord Quad Station began operations.
  • February 8:
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line began operations between Angelica Moss Station and Oblique Spit Station.
    • Passageway between Nawis Railway Polywood Station and Cities Transit Polywood Station demolished.
  • February 9: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Rice Lake Station began operations.
  • February 10: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Afflushore Station began operations.
  • February 12: Element Hub Transit Evillow Express began operations.
  • February 29: Metro Express Transport West Metropolis Line completed construction.
  • March 19: PTT. Railway Greenwood Line Cameilla Swamp Station began operations.
  • August 1: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express Arrowhead Station began operations.
  • August 2: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line extends its service up to Hillly Strings Station.
  • August 3: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line and Evillow Express completed construction.

2025[]

  • February 12: Continuous Phase 8 Routes announced.
  • February 14: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Trench Island Station began operations.
  • February 16: Haruna City Railway Reiher Line began operations between Chun Po Community Station and Shark-A Cove Station.
  • March 1: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express Walnut Tree Station began operations.
  • March 3: Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express Tai Wan Peninsula Station began operations.
  • June 3: Frosview Railway ceased operations. Samui Line was handed over to Mushroom Transit (MT).
  • July 1: Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line began operations between Neon Top Station and Chosen Surge Station.
  • July 11: Continuous Phase 9 Routes announced.
  • July 14: Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Manking Station began operations.
  • August 3: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Inception Bay North Station began operations.
  • August 5: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Inception Bay Pier Station began operations.
  • August 11: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Kaifong Stadium Station began operations.
  • August 26: Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Church Creek Station began operations.
  • September 21: Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Forest Tip Station began operations.
  • October 5: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Halozy Station began operations.
  • October 6: Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Constell Ponds Station began operations.
  • October 22: Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line , Ascentcloud Express Hongwood Station began operations.
  • October 31: Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Cerulean Sea Station began operations.

2026[]

  • January 16: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line extends to Python Delta Station.
  • January 18: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line extends to Nagasora Station.
  • January 19: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line extends to Le Monde Station.
  • March 20: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line extends to LSIST Station.
  • March 21: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line extends to Affluna Cove Station.
  • March 23: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line extends to Shiromi Station.
  • April 12: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line extends to Roentgen Station.
  • July 20: Nawis Railway Masquerade Line extends to Regent Park Station.
  • August 1:
    • Phantasia Metro Fuurin Line began operations between Lens Station and Barren Valley Station.
    • Phantasia Metro Fuurin Line began operations between Lens Station and High Parallel Station.
  • August 21: Great City Railway (GCR) Lakebound Line began operations.

Qualifications to Apply[]

  • Starting From March 4 2022:
    • Current Co-Op Railway owners who have completed their existing development and wanted to continue development can contact Nazca.
    • Players who did not participate in the Sandbox Server who are also interested in development and did not have any previous experience can also contact Nazca.

safeHtml:
This Page highlights the Los Sengas Regulations on classification and registration of Media organizations written by the Media and Broadcasting Authority (MBA) of the Los Sengas Government in both Chinese and English. It is written with the purpose of regulating Los Sengas Media as follows:

Contents

  • 1 立例目的 Aim of regulation
  • 2 釋義 Interpretation
  • 3 媒體分類 Classification of Media Organizations
  • 4 媒體註冊程序 Registration of Media Organizations
  • 5 媒體牌照檢討 Media License Reviews
  • 6 媒體機構代號及發帖規定 Regulations on posts
  • 7 附表A 公共廣播機構列表 Appendix A List of Public Service Broadcasters
  • 8 附表B 持牌媒體機構列表 Appendix B List of Licensed Media Organizations (媒體類別代碼:LMO)

立例目的 Aim of regulation[]

為辨別媒體公司人員及普通市民，及協助合資格媒體人員得到管理人員適當協助
To identify personnels of Media organizations from ordinary citizens and to offer appropriate aid when needed.

釋義 Interpretation[]

在本規定 中，除文意另有所指外─
"總管理長"(chief administrator)指納斯卡計劃伺服器總管理長;
"傳媒主管"(media director)指納斯卡計劃伺服器傳媒主管;
"政府"指洛聖加政府。

In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires-
"Chief administrator"means the chief administrator of the Project Nazca Server;
"Media director"means the media director of the Project Nazca Server;
"government"means the government of Los Sengas;

媒體分類 Classification of Media Organizations[]

3.1.公共廣播機構(IGMG)
3.2.持牌媒體機構: 經指定程序獲政府發牌的媒體機構

3.1.Public Service Broadcaster-the public corporation which provides media services(IGMG)
3.2.Licensed Media Organization- Media organizations licensed through a certain procedure

媒體註冊程序 Registration of Media Organizations[]

4.1持牌媒體機構Licensed Media Organizations
持牌媒體機構負責人必需向政府提交完整計劃書, 經會議通過後發牌 A proposal should be submitted to the general meeting of the server, and be approved by two-third of the participants present.

媒體牌照檢討 Media License Reviews[]

公共廣播機構及持牌媒體機構之牌照需每年檢討乙次, 以確保公共廣播機構及持牌媒體機構之質素。檢討前, 公共廣播機構及持牌媒體機構之負責人需向會議提交一份報告, 清說明其年度內所製作之內容, 及其來年發展方向。
政府可決定不為一媒體機構延續其牌照, 但必需預留一定通知期*

  • 此安排不適用於公共廣播機構

To maintain quality of the Public Service Broadcaster and the licensed media organizations,the review of media licenses shall be conducted annually.Before the review,the person in-charge of the organization reviewed should submit a report containing their productions produced and their future plans.
The government may decide not to renew the license for a media organization,but adequate time should be given.*

  • this is not applicable to the Public Service Broadcaster

媒體機構代號及發帖規定 Regulations on posts[]

所有媒體機構均將在注冊後獲編配一個代碼,以方便讀者識別其媒體類別及名稱。

所有媒體機構之發帖均須於其開首以以下格式書明其所屬機構,否則政府可在無需通知之情況下刪除其帖子-
[媒體類別]-[名稱代碼]
All posts issued by all media organizations shall show its code at the beginning of the post in the following format-

[media category]-[code of media organization]

If any media organization fail to comply with the regualtion listed in section 7.1, the MBA may delete the post violating the rule without further notice.

safeHtml:
Los Sengas Route Map (Chinese: 洛聖加鐵路路網圖), LS Route Map in short, are routemaps integrating all of railways in Los Sengas. There are at least four different versions for the map, each with different contributor.

History[]

The idea of integrating all lines into one picture was proposed in January, 2017, by Gaber_WS, who was known as Admin of Legacy World in 2017. The first map of "ver. G" was published at January 13 and received positive responses. The later recreation after the first map was successively published in 2019, 2022 and 2023 and, by different contributors EarthManIsMe, HistoricPotato and CLK#5573 (Mayseng Matters).

Version G.[]

  • January, 2017: The idea of integrating all lines in Los Sengas is proposed by Gaber_WS.
  • January 13, 2017: The first version of "Ver. G" was published, which was drawn by PAINT.NET.
  • February 24, 2017: Drawing of the second version of "Ver. G" begins.
  • March 4, 2017: The west part of second version of "Ver. G" was released. However, the east part was never released due to the leaving of contributor in 5-1 Incident.
  • August 13, 2022: After the contributor's return. The third version of "Ver. G" was released and shared to the Facebook page of Nazca Railway.
  • May, 2023: Drawing of the fourth version of "Ver. G" begins and was drawn by Adobe Illustrator.
  • May 21, 2023: Version 4.0 was published.

Version E.[]

  • April, 2019: The planning of drawing "Ver. E" begins.
  • May 19, 2019: The first version was published.
  • August 29, 2019: The second version was published.

Version M.[]

  • May 6, 2023: Discord user CLK#5573 (Mayseng Matters) released "Ver. M" showing operating train service in Los Sengas.

Version P.[]

  • May 9, 2022: The first version was published.
  • January 16, 2024: The second version was published.

title: Los Sengas Transport
safeHtml:
Los Sengas Transport mainly consists of public transport. While rail transport in Los Sengas is the most prominent, water transport and road transport are also available. Moreover, private transport comes in the form of Horse Spawning Stations and Elytra.

Contents

  • 1 Aviation Transport
    • 1.1 Airports
    • 1.2 Airlines
    • 1.3 Aeropspace Development
    • 1.4 Elytra
  • 2 Rail Transport
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
    • 2.2 Sava Light Transit
    • 2.3 Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme
    • 2.4 Others
    • 2.5 Connecting Rail Systems
      • 2.5.1 HAMGOSASHI LRT
  • 3 Maritime Transport
    • 3.1 Passenger Ferries

  • 4 Road Transport

  • 6 Private Transport
  • 7 Citations and References

Aviation Transport[]

Airports[]

Currently, Los Sengas has one airport. However, plans to build the Los Sengas International and Intergalactic Transport Hub (SITH) in the Egress Continent are also in place, and Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport is also under construction.

  • Mayler Airport (Sava Threeler, Private Airport, now transforming into a public airport)
  • Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport (Under Reconstruction)
  • Los Sengas International and Intergalactic Transport Hub (Proposed)

Airlines[]

The following are the airlines that have been registered under the Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation:

  • Metropolis Airline
  • Nazca Railway Affiliated Airline Corporation
  • Hatace Airlines Corporation

Aeropspace Development[]

The following are the aerospace development companies that have been registered under the Policy of Los Sengas Permanent Corporation:

  • Domma Aviation Industry

Elytra[]

Elytras are a form of private air transport in Los Sengas that can rival road transport.

Rail Transport[]

The most prominent rail operator in Los Sengas is Nazca Railway, and the Los Sengas Division and Sava Light Transit (SLT) are both set in here. However, under the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme, other private rail company operators also provided railway servcies in Los Sengas. Rail transport in Los Sengas is managed by Nazca.

Nazca Railway[]

Nazca Railway is the most prominent rail operator in Los Sengas, and it has stations across all different districts. In some areas, such as the Twenty-Second Continent, the rail network is even more well developed than the road network. This railway company can legally build railways across districts.

Sava Light Transit[]

While Sava Light Transit begun as the light rail subsidiary of Nazca Railway, and is named after the fact that it mainly served Sava, the transport network of SLT has since expanded to all districts in Los Sengas, and is no longer under NR. This railway company can also legally build railways across districts.

Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme.

The Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme is a railway development scheme in Los Sengas for players to have the right to build railways to a limited extent and further enhance railway devleopment.

Others[]

Other private railways not involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme are usually based in West Metropolis Archipelago and is subject to West Metropolis Archipelago Regulations. In order to protect the balance of the WMA and not exceed player rights limits, cross-district railways are usually not possible.

Connecting Rail Systems[]

HAMGOSASHI LRT[]

HAMGOSASHI LRT is formerly the connecting rail system for Nazca Ferry. This company can also legally construct cross-district railways provided that the district has access to Nazca Ferry.

Maritime Transport[]

Most passenger ferries in Los Sengas is managed by Nazca Ferry, and container freight is managed by Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals, which is managed by MichaelLMY.

Passenger Ferries[]

Nazca Ferry has set up the Los Sengas division in Los Sengas, which provides passenger ferry services. It is currently the largest passenger ferry operator in Los Sengas. However, Hatace Ferry has also seen rapid development in Los Sengas and is preparing to expand operations to different districts. Other ferry operators also provide cross-island ferry services in West Metropolis Archipelago.

  • Nazca Ferry
  • Hatace Ferry
  • Peckern Ferry
  • Nazca Railway (Subsidiary Ferry Company)
  • Egret Docks Ferry Coporation Limited

Container Freight[]

Most Maritime Freight transport is highly dependent on the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals, the largest infrastructure project in Los Sengas to date. Moreover, Sanfo Island, Bulldoze Island and Hatace Island Governments have also set up their own minor container terminals on their own islands, and Miner Bay Depot of Nazca Railway also features its exclusive container terminal for train assembly.

Road Transport[]

The Road Transport Network in Los Sengas Continent is the most well-devleoped. However, most islands on West Metropolis Archipelago also have road networks on their own, which are respectively managed by their district administrators and developers.

Trunk Roads[]

Los Sengas has 20 public trunk roads which are named routes and 5 private trunk roads.

Other Roads[]

Currently, road networks at Downtown, Sava, West Metropolis Archipelago and Peckern Continent are the densest, and road networks in other areas are more sparse. While Nazca Railway tends to construct roads at the vicinity of new stations after Season 2, most roads on islands on West Metropolis Archipelago do not have external access.

Bus Network[]

The bus network in Los Sengas was managed by Department of Highways and Motor Vehicles, and the first round of bus licences and route registration commenced on August 31 2016. However, the management of the network was handed over to the United Council of Bus Companies in Los Sengas (LSUCBC) when it was established on August 15 2018.

More info on Los Sengas Bus routes can be seen here.

Private Transport[]

Due to server performance limitations, Los Sengas forbids the usage of "Spawn Eggs" for players. Only the publicly operated Horse Spawning Stations feature this service. Moreover, Elytras are also a popular choice of private transport.

title: Los Sengas Trunk Roads
safeHtml:
Los Sengas Trunk Roads act as main arteries for Los Sengas land transport, and provides direct and convenient access between different districts of Los Sengas.

Earlier Trunk Roads (Routes 1-7) are paved with gray concrete, whereas newer Trunk Roads, including newer sections of Route 7 and Routes numbered 8 or above, uses gray concrete instead. Most Trunk roads have more than two lanes for each side and are dual carriageways. All exits are either set on the left side of the road or are graded junctions. Moreover, a large majority of the trunk roads in Los Sengas are Motorways, and unlike in Hong Kong, tunnels can also be considered a part of the motorway. However, it is forbidden to change lanes in tunnels.

While the Trunk roads are formerly managed by the Department of Highways and Motor Vehicles, since the dissolvence of the Los Sengas Government, they are now managed by players instead.

Most early Trunk Roads do not have section names, but all Trunk Roads after Number 6 have Section names.

LosSengas World Expo Station was a planned station on Eastcoast Line. It would have been operated by Peckern Transit, and would have been located in Peckern Gull Woods. However, due to changes in development plans, this station was never built.

Fun Facts[]

  • While the plans for Eastcoast Line were scrapped, the section between Beak Beach Station and Stone Shoal Station became a part of the Peckern South-East Coast Line. The Station corresponding to this station on Peckern South-East Coast Line is LSWorld-Expo Station.

title: Lower Bufly Tunnel
safeHtml:
Lower Bufly Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division. It is located beneath the Upper Bufly Tunnel and is used for rolling stock storage and buffer tracks for Luxter Line.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 2
  • Length: 221 m
  • Lines Served: Luxter Line Buffer Tracks
  • Location: None (Used for buffering, rolling stock storage)

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • It was formerly the shortest underwater tunnel in Los Sengas. However, this record was later broken by Birdlet Tunnel.

Citations and References []

  • List of Los Sengas NR Tunnels

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station is similar to Kau Liu Ha Tsuen, a village in Hong Kong, and the Chinese Name of this station is a similar translation to the Shack. As a result, this station involves the usage of Birch Wood.
  • Due to the low expected ridership, this station adopts a more suburban design in a fashion similar to Blackstone Village Station, with low numbers of connections between the concourse and the platforms, and a smaller number of exits.

History[]

  • May 21 2020: This station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station (Lowwwind) has three small letter 'w's in a fashion similar to Taiiin Hill Station in Terracept Division. The three 'w's refer to "low-woodwind".
  • The design of this station pays tribute to Golden Oak Station in Terracept Division.
  • Due to underdevelopment in the vicinity at the time this station was built, this station was once not accessible from the ground level until July 5 2026.
  • The station number of Evillow Line for this station was EV-19. However, it has later been changed to EV-21 due to Station Number rearrangements.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is colored green due to the popular belief that Four-leaf Clovers bring in good luck.[3]
  • This station, alongside Barode Cave Station and Key River Station, is one of the "anchor points" for Glacier Line climbing to Elevated level from the north. As a result, Side Platforms are used for this station. This station also corresponds to the design of Qoser Coast Station.
  • Despite being a Ground Level Station, the platforms of this station are completely sealed off.
  • A Toilet Exhibition is constructed near Exit D of the station.

History[]

  • December 9 2020: This Station completed construction.[4]
  • December 10 2020: This station began services.

Luk Ming Street Station is a station on Downtown Loop Line (Metropolis Branch Line). It is operated by Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu, and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Phantasia Metro Bonyal to Cyan Loop Line (South Greenrock Hill Station).

Luk Tsuen Station is a station on Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 1L, Line 102, Line 103 (Luk Tsuen Road Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • There is an existing SLT Station at the location of this station. However, unlike Spring Stone Station, where the entirety of the Station is built under the SLT Station (Luk Tsuen Road Stop), the SLT Station involved has a set of platforms on ground level and another set underground. As a result, the Concourse is placed above the underground SLT Platforms, whereas the Platforms of this station is placed below the SLT Station, with a dedicated concourse leading to the SLT Platforms.
  • This Station is named after Luk Tsuen Road. However, the road runs in perpendicular fashion with the Station.[2] In Turn, Luk Tsuen Road is named after the fact that it lays between Greenrock Hill and Metro Spring.[3]

History[]

  • July 23 2022: This station completed construction.[4]
  • July 24 2022: This station began services. Phoenix Line is established.
  • April 9 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • February 10 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]
  • July 8 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.
